records.name: Chevening Scholarships
records.summary: Chevening Scholarships are fully funded awards for outstanding emerging leaders from around the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK. Eligibility is administered by country.
records.sourceNotes: The source states applicants come from all over the world, but eligibility is country-specific.
records.evidence: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK. Chevening Scholarships are fully-funded, leaving you free to focus on achieving your professional goals.

records.name: Government of Ireland – International Education Scholarships 2026
records.summary: The Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships 2026 at University College Cork provide a full tuition fee waiver and a EUR 10,000 stipend for one year of full-time NFQ level 9 master's study. Awards are limited to the programmes listed on the UCC page.
records.sourceTitle: Government of Ireland – International Education Scholarships 2026
records.evidence: Value: full fee waiver and EUR 10,000 stipend for one year's study. The scholarship at UCC will be for one year of full-time, in-person study at NFQ level 9 (Masters) in Ireland.

records.name: Ireland Fellows Programme
records.summary: The Ireland Fellows Programme is fully funded by the Irish Government and offers selected students a one-year master's-level programme at a higher education institution in Ireland. The award covers programme fees, flights, accommodation and living costs.
records.sourceNotes: Eligible countries are programme-specific and are not enumerated on this overview page.
records.evidence: The fellowship offers selected students the opportunity to undertake a fully funded one-year master's level programme at a higher education institution (HEI) in Ireland. The award covers programme fees, flights, accommodation and living costs.

records.name: Marshall Scholarships
records.summary: Marshall Scholarships are fully funded graduate awards open only to United States citizens, covering university fees, living expenses and other costs. The source describes study at graduate level and mentions extensions for doctorate students.
records.sourceNotes: Degree levels are inferred as master's and PhD from the source's graduate-level and doctorate wording.
records.evidence: Eligibility: Open only to United States citizens who (at the time they take up their Scholarship) hold a first degree from an accredited four-year college or university in the United States. Value: University fees, cost of living expenses, annual book grant, thesis grant, research and daily travel grants, fares to and from the United States.

records.name: Rhodes Scholarship
records.summary: The Rhodes Scholarship is a fully funded postgraduate award at the University of Oxford for talented people from around the world. It covers course fees and provides an annual stipend, and scholars may study in almost any field.
records.sourceNotes: The source says scholars can study in almost any field; field scope is recorded as ALL.
records.evidence: The Rhodes Scholarship is a fully-funded postgraduate award which enables talented people from around the world to study full-time at the University of Oxford. The Rhodes Scholarship covers University of Oxford course fees, as well as providing an annual stipend. Rhodes Scholars can apply to study most full-time postgraduate courses in almost any field offered by Oxford University.

records.name: Gates Cambridge (All Other Eligible Applicants)
records.summary: Gates Cambridge offers full-cost scholarships to outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK for postgraduate study in any subject at the University of Cambridge. This record covers the international round for all other eligible applicants.
records.sourceNotes: The source states countries outside the UK and 255 nationalities but does not enumerate them on this page.
records.evidence: Each year Gates Cambridge offers c. 75 full-cost scholarships to outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

records.name: Cambridge Trust International Scholarship
records.summary: The Cambridge Trust International Scholarship covers international fees, maintenance and other costs for eligible PhD students at the University of Cambridge. It is tenable in any subject excluding premium-rate courses.
records.sourceNotes: The source states all countries except UK and Ireland; the full country list is not enumerated on this page.
records.evidence: Fees (International), Maintenance, Student visa cost, Student immigration health surcharge, Other (see below). The scholarships are tenable at any College of the University of Cambridge and in any subject, excluding premium rate courses.

records.name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
records.providerName: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
records.summary: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships support full-time doctoral study at a UK university for applicants from listed least developed countries and vulnerable states in the Commonwealth. The award covers approved tuition fees and provides a stipend.
records.sourcePublisher: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
records.sourceNotes: Eligible countries are listed on the source page; ISO2 codes were mapped from that list.
records.evidence: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships are for applicants from least developed countries and vulnerable states, as classified by the OECD Development Assistance Committee (DAC), in the Commonwealth, for full-time doctoral study at a UK university. Approved tuition fees: full fees are covered by agreement between the CSC and the UK university. Stipend (living allowance) at the rate of GBP 1,712 per month.

records.name: Sanctuary Scholarship
records.summary: The University of Birmingham Sanctuary Scholarship is open to anybody from any country and any nationality. It covers full tuition, a GBP 5,000 annual stipend and accommodation.
records.evidence: Full tuition, GBP 5k per year stipend & accommodation. Open to anybody from any country and any nationality.

records.name: University of Galway–China Scholarship Council Joint Scholarship for PhD Study
records.summary: The University of Galway–China Scholarship Council Joint Scholarship for PhD Study provides up to 15 PhD tuition-fee waivers with no subject restrictions. The China Scholarship Council covers living costs and flight tickets.
records.sourceNotes: Funding combines a University of Galway tuition-fee waiver with CSC living costs and flights; classified fully funded on that basis.
records.evidence: Up to 15 PhD tuition-fee waivers from University of Galway with no subject restrictions. CSC will cover the living costs and flight tickets.

records.name: E3 Excellence Postgraduate Scholarships
records.summary: E3 Excellence Postgraduate Scholarships provide EUR 1,000 to EUR 5,000 reductions toward first-year tuition fees for full-time postgraduate taught students in listed engineering, natural sciences, energy and environmental history areas.
records.sourceTitle: E3 Excellence Postgraduate Scholarships in Engineering, Environment and Emerging Technologies.
records.evidence: Scholarships valued at 1000 to 5000 euro each, applied as a reduction to the tuition fees of a full-time postgraduate programme for the first year of study only. Full-time taught postgraduate programmes in the School of Engineering, the School of Natural Sciences, MSc in Energy Science and the MPhil in Environmental History.

records.name: Global Excellence Undergraduate Scholarships
records.summary: Trinity College Dublin's Global Excellence Undergraduate Scholarships provide EUR 2,000 to EUR 5,000 reductions toward first-year tuition fees for exceptional international undergraduate students. Students from China are not eligible.
records.sourceNotes: The source states students from China are not eligible.
records.evidence: Scholarships range in value between EUR 2,000 and EUR 5,000 depending on the region. Scholarships are applied as a reduction to the year one tuition fees of a full-time undergraduate programme. Students from China are not eligible to apply.

records.name: UCD Global Excellence Scholarships
records.summary: UCD Global Excellence Scholarships offer 100% and 50% tuition fee scholarships to outstanding international students entering undergraduate and graduate taught programmes. They are open only to students classed as non-EU for fee purposes.
records.sourceNotes: The source states the scholarship is only open to incoming students classed as non-EU for tuition fee purposes.
records.evidence: Funding provided: 100% and 50% tuition fee scholarships. Limited 100% and 50% tuition fee scholarships for outstanding international students applying to undergraduate and graduate taught programmes only. This scholarship is ONLY open to incoming students who are classed as non-EU for tuition fee purposes.

records.name: Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships
records.summary: Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships are fully funded master's awards that cover tuition fees, a living allowance and return economy flights to the host country. The host institution and country vary by award.
records.sourceNotes: Host country varies by award; the source does not specify a single host country.
records.evidence: Fully-funded tuition fees. Living allowance (stipend) for duration of award. Return economy flights to host country.

records.name: Think Big Scholarships
records.summary: Think Big Scholarships are University of Bristol awards providing funding toward tuition fees for international students on eligible undergraduate or postgraduate courses. Eligible courses include any undergraduate course and any one-year postgraduate taught or master's by research programme.
records.sourceTitle: Think Big Scholarships for international students
records.evidence: Think Big is the University of Bristol's flagship scholarship scheme, providing funding towards tuition fees for international students studying eligible undergraduate or postgraduate courses. Any undergraduate course for up to four years of study delivered in person. Any one-year postgraduate taught or master's by research programme delivered in person.

records.name: Global Futures Scholarships
records.summary: The University of Manchester's Global Futures Scholarships are partial merit-based awards for undergraduate and master's students from eligible countries. More than 350 scholarships are offered for 2027 entry.
records.sourceNotes: Eligible countries are listed on the source page; ISO2 codes were mapped from that list.
records.evidence: For 2027 entry, we have more than 350 partial merit-based scholarships open to both undergraduate and master's students.

records.name: Vice President International Scholar Award
records.summary: The Vice President International Scholar Award at Maynooth University offers a EUR 7,500 tuition fee discount to two outstanding postgraduate taught international applicants. Applicants must be non-EU fee-paying students.
records.sourceNotes: The source states applicants must be non-EU fee-paying students.
records.evidence: The Vice President International Scholar Award offers a EUR 7,500 tuition fee discount to two outstanding Postgraduate Taught international applicants who have demonstrated exceptional academic achievement in previous studies. Be a Non-EU fee-paying student.

records.name: UL University of Sanctuary Scholarship
records.summary: The UL University of Sanctuary Scholarship provides tuition fee waivers to first-time higher education applicants in Ireland who are refugees, asylum seekers or people in refugee-like situations. It is available for eligible full-time undergraduate and one-year taught postgraduate programmes.
records.evidence: The UL University of Sanctuary Scholarship provides tuition fee waivers (ie, no fees) to first-time higher education applicants who identify as a refugee, asylum seeker or a person in a refugee-like situation and who have made an application for International Protection in Ireland.

records.name: Clarendon Scholarships
records.providerName: University of Oxford Faculty of Law
records.summary: Clarendon Scholarships are fully funded Oxford University awards for new graduate students with no restrictions on nationality, ordinary residence or field of study. They cover course fees and maintenance costs, and Oxford Law applicants are nominated by the Faculty.
records.sourcePublisher: University of Oxford Faculty of Law
records.sourceNotes: This is a Law Faculty funding page; Law Faculty nomination applies to Oxford Law applicants.
records.evidence: An Oxford University funding programme open to new graduate students with no restrictions on nationality, ordinary residence or field of study. Value: Course fees Maintenance costs. As part of the admissions process, the Law Faculty will decide which applicants to nominate to the University for a Clarendon Scholarship.

records.name: Vice-Chancellor’s Postgraduate International Scholarship
records.summary: The Vice-Chancellor's Postgraduate International Scholarship at Cardiff University offers GBP 4,000 to GBP 10,000 tuition fee discounts to eligible international postgraduate taught students.
records.evidence: Awards between GBP 4,000 to GBP 10,000 will be granted to eligible postgraduate-taught students and will be offered in the form of a tuition fee discount.
